children.value: > Fact From Story: The latter hopes to prove that Google engages in anticompetitive behavior with regard to its Android app store, Google Play, and its commission structure.

> > Fact From Story: This case will differ slightly from Epic’s battle with Apple on the same topic because, this time, Epic can’t allege there’s no other way to load apps onto Android devices, as it could with Apple, because Android does allow for sideloading apps.
> > Fact From Story: On November 6, Google went to trial with Fortnite maker Epic Games.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: November 6th is in November.
> Fact From Story: On November 6, Google went to trial with Fortnite maker Epic Games.

> > Fact From Story: Fortnite maker Epic Games is still set to go to trial with the tech giant today, November 6, in hopes of convincing a jury that Google engages in anticompetitive behavior with regard to its Android app store, Google Play, and its commission structure.

> > > Fact From Story: The precedent Epic’s case will rely on is a Microsoft case where courts found Microsoft to have a monopoly over the operating system and were abusing it, making it hard for users to download alternative browsers, like Netscape, on Windows devices.

> > > Fact From Story: This case will differ slightly from Epic’s battle with Apple on the same topic because, this time, Epic can’t allege there’s no other way to load apps onto Android devices, as it could with Apple, because Android does allow for sideloading apps.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A trial involves presenting evidence and arguments in court.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A trial is a type of court case.
> Commonsense Knowledge: November 6th is in November.
